holds.candidate: Auckland Surf Park Community Stage 2 data centre precinct, Dairy Flat
holds.reason: The November 23 EPA panel records confirm that the Stage 2 application is still being assessed. The application covers multiple properties and separate uses. The reviewed civic addresses identify the wider mixed-use park; a coordinate specific to the data centre precinct has yet to be verified.

CDC names both operating Auckland campuses in its November 2026 announcement. Its undated Auckland commercial page separately states that Silverdale Campus One has 22 MW of operating capacity. The September 16 investor presentation classifies individually named facilities as of June 30. The September 15 corporate carbon certificate covers the reporting year ending March 31. The November release states only a month. Its official sitemap last-modified timestamp records a web revision and does not state the day of publication or physical observation. The public Marketplace roster lists the company as an approved supplier.
holds.reopen_condition: Recent day-specific original reporting confirming operation of this named commercial facility, or a reviewed admission path for genuine month-precision observations.

holds.candidate: Contact Energy / CDC proposed Stratford data centre
holds.reason: Contact and CDC identify the proposed commercial facility near the former Taranaki Combined Cycle plant. Contact labels up to 250 MW as an estimate of proposed IT load. Stratford District Council records joint applicant file 523/2026, external reference P3345, lodged November 9, 2026 and active. Its detailed register lists nine properties spanning Beaconsfield Road and East Road. It includes the existing power-station address. The first-listed number 774 also appears in the separate, much larger solar landholding in the national land investment register. The council’s generic map and Contact’s illustrative rendering do not isolate the data-centre site or future subdivided lot. The record supports application-stage development only.
holds.reopen_condition: Public council or developer data centre site plan, exact proposed allotment or geographic planning boundary that distinguishes the data centre from the larger multi-use application land. See the council register result for 523/2026; its session-relative detail link can point to a different case in other sessions.
